description: Fetch a Quora topic page by slug: returns topic metadata and one of three sections — Read (mixed answer/question feed), top_questions (open questions), or writers (most viewed writers by 30-day answer views). Uses GraphQL when available and falls back to visible DOM extraction if the page structure drifts.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic slug, i.e. the last path segment of https://www.quora.com/topic/<slug>. Examples: Technology, Artificial-Intelligence, Creative-Writing.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which topic tab to return: read (default, mixed answer/question feed), top_questions (open questions in this topic), or writers (most viewed writers ranked by 30-day answer views).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100, default 20). read and top_questions lazy-load; writers is a fixed short list and will return all available if fewer than limit.
